findings.what_would_reject: A Code-GSM price change that HalabTech does not follow while HalabTech's price moves with another source; or HalabTech/Code-GSM both showing the same price deltas vs a third server's price changes.
findings.supports_or_contradicts: Supports REL-097 (LIKELY). Resolves CL-013/V-07: no listing-vs-detail conflict today (listing = rounded detail price).

findings.claim: UnlocksPro's earliest IMEI capture (28 Mar 2023) already used HalabTech's 'USA Reseller Flex' group with names HalabTech posted in 2021-2023 and HalabTech's typo 'Blacklist Prheck (GSMA)'; by 21 Jul 2024 it listed HalabTech's '[NEW JDM V4 V5] / [V2 V3] SAMSUNG Repair Netowrk/Demo/Unlock' groups verbatim (HalabTech's 'Netowrk' family exists on HalabTech by 24 Mar 2023), and only later reformatted them.
findings.excerpt: [NEW JDM V4 V5] SAMSUNG Repair Netowrk/Demo/Unlock ... Fix Demo [PATCH 1/7/2023 And after] | Miniutes | $ 39.99 491430.74UZS
findings.pub_date: Wayback 2023-03-28 and 2024-07-21 (UnlocksPro); HalabTech 2023-03-24 capture; HalabTech Telegram Reseller Flex posts 2021-02-28 to 2023-03-28
findings.alternative_explanations: Both could import from a common CPID/Reseller-Flex upstream that uses HalabTech-like names; HalabTech could have imported later items (e.g. Signal Labs) from UnlocksPro even if older items flowed the other way.
findings.contradicting_evidence: UnlocksPro's live JDM list adds models (S506DL, S515DL, A055F) missing from HalabTech's, and HalabTech's TFN item adds others (X216B, A055M, X218U, A055G); some UnlocksPro names keep older model ranges with 'Direct Source ✅' suffixes (e.g. Reseller Flex 'Up to 17 Series' vs HalabTech 'Up to 18 Series').
findings.what_would_confirm: UnlocksPro JDM orders answered with HalabTech's reply texts; UnlocksPro's MDM Source 1# orders processed by HalabTech.
findings.what_would_reject: An UnlocksPro capture showing these names before HalabTech had them.
findings.supports_or_contradicts: Resolves REL-098 direction for the shared IMEI names: downstream (LIKELY). Reinterprets B-03, B-05, B-06.
findings.notes: Overlap counts: UnlocksPro 2023-03-28 vs HalabTech 2023-03-24: 38 exact names; UnlocksPro 2024-07-21 vs HalabTech 2026-10-11: 15 exact group names, 34 exact service names. UnlocksPro's '#25582 Tecno/iTel/Infinix ONLY MDM Remove Permanent Unlock By Imei +Lock Pic Instant to 72 Hours Source 1# [Premium]' equals HalabTech's 2026-02-10 name (HalabTech has since shortened it). 2024 prices were shown in USD and UZS.

findings.claim: UnlocksPro's '#NNNNN' prefixes are its own Dhru service ids (pid=26234 opens its 'Signal Labs | Technology Service' group, id 4860), added to names only after July 2024; none of these numbers (#22343-22349, #26234-26268) appear in any HalabTech name, so the embedded-id test gives no sign that HalabTech imported from UnlocksPro.
findings.excerpt: Home / Signal Labs | Technology Service / Continue to place order for this service?
findings.alternative_explanations: HalabTech could import without carrying ids (Dhru imports never carry the supplier's id into the name unless the supplier shows it), so absence of ids does not prove direction by itself.
findings.contradicting_evidence: UnlocksPro's Signal Labs pair #26234/#26235 is consecutive, matching HalabTech's two 'New Service' posts of 27 Aug 2026; order of creation between the two servers cannot be fixed from ids.
findings.what_would_confirm: UnlocksPro creating #26234 after 27 Aug 2026 (e.g., Wayback capture without it on/after that date).
findings.what_would_reject: A dated UnlocksPro page listing #26234 before 27 Aug 2026.
findings.supports_or_contradicts: Answers REL-098 point 3: ids are native to UnlocksPro; they are not embedded in HalabTech names.
findings.notes: Wayback 2023-03-28 and 2024-07-21 UnlocksPro lists have no '#2xxxx' prefixes (only legacy '#2765'/'#102' upstream artefacts). UnlocksPro lacks HalabTech's 19 Sep 2026 Signal Labs item 'Google Pixel Carrier Unlock Windows Tool )'. Guest price on the cart page is $0 (hidden), so no same-time price test was possible (H2.4).

findings.claim: UnlocksPro publishes only support@unlockspro.com, a Telegram contact account @unlockspro_com and the Dhru placeholder address; its 2024 price list showed a UZS (Uzbek som) conversion, and no phone, email or Telegram shared with HalabTech was found.
findings.alternative_explanations: UZS display may be a default currency option, not the operator's country.
findings.what_would_confirm: Domain RDAP/WHOIS or payment details naming an Uzbek operator.
findings.supports_or_contradicts: REL-098: no shared identity with HalabTech (not a sibling/same-owner server on current evidence).
findings.notes: Wayback: www.unlockspro.com/robots.txt 2016-10-19; homepage 2021-12-29; Telegram contact seen in 2025-05-15 capture footer. RDAP request failed.

findings.claim: HalabTech's five Signal Labs prices are computed markups on round costs (20.643 = 17.95 × 1.15; 22.438 = 17.95 × 1.25; 5.625 = 4.50 × 1.25; 27.438 = 21.95 × 1.25; 6.913 ≈ 5.53 × 1.25), so HalabTech buys them by API at about $17.95/$21.95/$4.50/$5.53 from a supplier that cannot be UnlocksPro if W3-09/W3-10 hold.
findings.excerpt: 🆕 New Service Signal Labs Technology Tool (Google Pixel Carrier Unlock 100% Windows Tool | One Click |6|7|8|9|10 Series Supported)
findings.alternative_explanations: The multipliers could be HalabTech's manual pricing; UnlocksPro could still be a two-way partner for this one group.
findings.contradicting_evidence: UnlocksPro prices are hidden, so the $17.95/$21.95 fingerprint could not be tested against it.
findings.what_would_confirm: A public price list with Signal Labs tools at 17.95 / 21.95 / 4.50 / 5.53.
findings.supports_or_contradicts: Updates B-15 (HalabTech first posted Signal Labs on 27 Aug 2026, not 19 Sep).
